shortDescription: PARSIPPANY, NJ, Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Interpace Biosciences, Inc. ("Interpace" or the "Company") OTCID:IDXG today announced that it expects preliminary, unaudited revenue for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 to range from $10.1 million to $10.4 million.The expected revenue ran…

children: today announced that it expects preliminary, unaudited revenue for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 to range from $10.1 million to $10.4 million.

The expected revenue range represents an increase of approximately 11% to 14% compared with revenue of $9.1 million for the second quarter of 2026 and an increase of approximately 15% to 18% compared with revenue of $8.8 million for the third quarter of 2025.

The estimated revenue presented in this release is preliminary and unaudited, is based on information currently available to management, and remains subject to completion of the Company’s quarter-end closing procedures and review by the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm. Actual results may differ, including materially, from the range presented above. The Company expects to report complete financial results for the third quarter of 2026 at a later date.

Interpace Biosciences is an emerging leader in enabling personalized medicine through specialized molecular diagnostic tests and related services. The Company’s commercialized thyroid tests include ThyGeNEXT® and ThyraMIR®v2, which are used together to support the evaluation of indeterminate thyroid nodules. For more information, please visit
